mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) may potentiate neuromuscular blockade effects of methocarbamol, and both agents can cause CNS depression; concurrent use increases risk of respiratory depression and enhanced muscle relaxation.
action: Monitor for increased muscle weakness, respiratory depression, and CNS effects; consider dose reduction of methocarbamol or alternative antibiotics if clinically feasible; avoid concurrent use in patients with pre-existing neuromuscular disorders.
